cwe_content.cwe: CWE-401,Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime

candidate.Reason: Memory buffers are allocated with Buffer.Create() but only freed when createBuffers() is called again, not during cleanup. This creates a memory leak when the method is not called again before object destruction.
Memory buffers are properly freed during cleanup, but this method is only called when both inbound and outbound are closed. If the object is destroyed without proper cleanup, memory leaks occur.
SSL file descriptor resources are properly released, but this cleanup is dependent on explicit cleanup() calls. If the object is garbage collected without cleanup, NSS resources may leak.
Debug socket resources are properly closed during cleanup, but this cleanup is only performed when debug_port > 0 and cleanup() is explicitly called.
